comment: Read from the maker's source at 2.6.1, commit e6a0c67. The wavetables are twenty-four 238-byte tables selected by scratch*23 and converted to floats on the fly. The decay is knob*25 + 5, knob*170 + 30 or knob*3800 + 200 milliseconds for the three range positions. The four algorithm positions scale the reading differently: one passes the envelope alone, one folds it to a triangle across -5V to 5V, one multiplies by 160 times a value derived from the read rate and one by 12.5 + 25 times the chew setting. What CHEW does to the noise path beyond setting that multiplier was not established, so the line for it stays general. The panel has a RAT NEST MUSKRAT EXPANDER legend printed on it with no jack or control under it.
